compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer planar stack optimized with fixed alternating TiO2/SiO2 sequence. Reflectance maximized in 450–650 nm and transmittance maximized in 700–1000 nm at 45° incidence. Initial thicknesses for layers exceeding the hard 150 nm cap were clamped to 140.0 nm to satisfy solver bounds while preserving the design intent.
